Mean and sd

sim_mean_sd(n_obs = 30, 3, 1.2)
## # A tibble: 1 × 2
##    mean    sd
##   <dbl> <dbl>
## 1  5.15 0.867

keeping track of results

output = vector("list", 1000)

for (i in 1:10000) {
  output[[i]] = sim_mean_sd(n_obs = 30)
}

sim_results = bind_rows(output)
output |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  summarise(
    emp_m = mean(mean), 
    emp_sd = sd(mean)
  )
## # A tibble: 1 × 2
##   emp_m emp_sd
##   <dbl>  <dbl>
## 1  5.00  0.181
output |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean)) +
  geom_density()

Using tibbles and map instead

sim_results_df =
  tibble(
    samp_size = rep(30, 1000)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_mean_sd)
  )
sim_results_df = 
  expand_grid(
    sample_size = c(30, 60, 120, 240),
    iter = 1:1000
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    estimate_df = map(sample_size, sim_mean_sd)
  ) |> 
  unnest(estimate_df)
sim_results_df |> 
  mutate(
    sample_size = str_c("n = ", sample_size),
    sample_size = fct_inorder(sample_size)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = sample_size, y = mean, fill = sample_size)) +
  geom_boxplot()

Looking at number summaries

sim_results_df |> 
  pivot_longer(
    mean:sd,
    names_to = "parameter", 
    values_to = "estimate") |> 
  group_by(parameter, sample_size) |> 
  summarize(
    emp_mean = mean(estimate),
    emp_var = var(estimate)) |> 
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
## `summarise()` has regrouped the output.
## ℹ Summaries were computed grouped by parameter and sample_size.
## ℹ Output is grouped by parameter.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.groups = "drop_last")` to silence this message.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.by = c(parameter, sample_size))` for per-operation grouping
##   (`?dplyr::dplyr_by`) instead.
parameter sample_size emp_mean emp_var
mean 30 4.990 0.030
mean 60 4.995 0.016
mean 120 4.999 0.008
mean 240 5.002 0.004
sd 30 0.991 0.018
sd 60 0.996 0.008
sd 120 1.000 0.004
sd 240 0.996 0.002

SLR !

Generate once:

sim_data = 
    tibble(
      x = rnorm(30, mean = 1, sd = 1),
      y = 2 * x + rnorm(30, 0, 1)
    )
  
  

 sim_data |> 
   ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
   geom_point() +
   geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

turned into a function (source/sim_slr.R)

sim_slr(30)
## # A tibble: 1 × 2
##   beta0_hat beta1_hat
##       <dbl>     <dbl>
## 1      1.87      3.14
slr_results_df = 
  tibble(
    samp_size = rep(30, 1000)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    est_df = map(samp_size, sim_slr)
  ) |> 
  unnest(est_df)

Is it right

slr_results_df |> 
  summarize(
    b0_mean = mean(beta0_hat), 
    b0_se = sd(beta0_hat)
  )
## # A tibble: 1 × 2
##   b0_mean b0_se
##     <dbl> <dbl>
## 1    2.01 0.259

results

slr_results_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = beta0_hat, y = beta1_hat, color = beta0_hat)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )
